description: Rank Ethereum layer 2 networks by Total Value Secured (TVS) in USD, largest first. Answers "which L2 has the most value secured / is the biggest L2", and gives the top-10 leaderboard of rollups, validiums, optimiums and sidechains. Each row returns rank, project name, L2BEAT slug, category (Optimistic Rollup / ZK Rollup / Validium / Other), layer type, host chain, decentralisation stage, tvs_usd, the 7-day TVS change, and the TVS split across native, canonical, external, ether, stablecoin and BTC holdings. Covers every project L2BEAT tracks; use limit to widen the leaderboard.

category.description: Keep only one category, e.g. "Optimistic Rollup", "ZK Rollup", "Validium".

include_archived.description: Set true to also rank projects L2BEAT has archived (default false).

include_chart.description: Set true to append the 124-point ecosystem-wide TVS time series (default false).

limit.description: How many top-ranked projects to return (default 25, max 200).

name: list_projects

outputSchema.description: List of L2BEAT-tracked projects with summary data

title: List Projects
